segments.intent: Count active jobs mentioning both R and data visualization
segments.value:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS jobs_requiring_r_and_data_viz
FROM scout_postings
WHERE active = 1
  AND (
    lower(COALESCE(description, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%r%'
    OR lower(COALESCE(description, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%r programming%'
  )
  AND (
    lower(COALESCE(description, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%data viz%'
    OR lower(COALESCE(description, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%data visualization%'
    OR lower(COALESCE(description, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%data visualisation%'
  )
```
